segments.snp3.10:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.snp3.10:1.3: Atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:1.4: “pāpicchā, bhante, sāriputtamoggallānā, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā”ti.
segments.snp3.10:2.1: Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:3.1: Dutiyampi kho … pe … tatiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:3.3: “kiñcāpi me, bhante, bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko, atha kho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā”ti.
segments.snp3.10:3.4: Tatiyampi kho bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:4.1: Atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.snp3.10:4.2: Acirappakkantassa ca kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭo [phuṭṭho (syā.)] ahosi;
segments.snp3.10:4.3: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ; muggamattiyo hutvā kaḷāyamattiyo ahesuṃ; kaḷāyamattiyo hutvā kolaṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ; kolaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ; kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ; āmalakamattiyo hutvā beḷuvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ; beḷuvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ; billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu; pubbañca lohitañca pagghariṃsu.
segments.snp3.10:4.4: Atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu tenevābādhena kālamakāsi.
segments.snp3.10:4.5: Kālaṅkato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumaṃ nirayaṃ upapajji sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.
segments.snp3.10:5.1: Atha kho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ, ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:5.3: kālaṅkato ca, bhante, kokāliko bhikkhu padumaṃ nirayaṃ upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā”ti.
segments.snp3.10:5.5: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.snp3.10:6.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.snp3.10:6.2: “imaṃ, bhikkhave, rattiṃ brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā … pe … idamavoca, bhikkhave, brahmā sahampati, idaṃ vatvā maṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyī”ti.
segments.snp3.10:7.1: Evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.snp3.10:7.2: “kīvadīghaṃ nu kho, bhante, padume niraye āyuppamāṇan”ti?
segments.snp3.10:7.4: taṃ na sukaraṃ saṅkhātuṃ ettakāni vassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatāni iti vā ettakāni vassasahassāni iti vā ettakāni vassasatasahassāni iti vā”ti.
segments.snp3.10:7.5: “Sakkā pana, bhante, upamā [upamaṃ (sī. syā. ka.)] kātun”ti?
segments.snp3.10:8.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho; tato puriso vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena ekamekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya.
segments.snp3.10:8.2: Khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya, natveva eko abbudo nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati abbudā nirayā evameko nirabbudo nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.4: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evameko ababo nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.5: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati ababā nirayā evameko ahaho nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.7: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati ahahā nirayā evameko aṭaṭo nirayo. Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā evameko kumudo nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.8: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati kumudā nirayā evameko sogandhiko nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.9: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati sogandhikā nirayā evameko uppalako nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.10: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati uppalakā nirayā evameko puṇḍarīko nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.11: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā evameko padumo nirayo.
segments.snp3.10:8.12: Padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā”ti.
segments.snp3.10:8.13: Idamavoca bhagavā, idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.snp3.10:9.3: Yāya chindati attānaṃ, bālo dubbhāsitaṃ bhaṇaṃ.
segments.snp3.10:10.1: “Yo nindiyaṃ pasaṃsati, taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyo;
segments.snp3.10:10.3: Vicināti mukhena so kaliṃ, kalinā tena sukhaṃ na vindati.
segments.snp3.10:11.3: Sabbassāpi sahāpi attanā, ayameva mahattaro [mahantakaro (sī.)] kali;
segments.snp3.10:12.1: “Sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsati pañca ca abbudāni [abbudānaṃ (ka.)];
segments.snp3.10:12.3: Yamariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya pāpakaṃ.
segments.snp3.10:13.1: “Abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vāpi katvā na karomicāha;
segments.snp3.10:13.3: Ubhopi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.
segments.snp3.10:14.1: “Yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati, suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa;
segments.snp3.10:14.3: Tameva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ, sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃva khitto.
segments.snp3.10:15.1: “Yo lobhaguṇe anuyutto, so vacasā paribhāsati aññe;
segments.snp3.10:15.3: Asaddho kadariyo avadaññū, macchari pesuṇiyaṃ [pesuṇiyasmiṃ (bahūsu)] anuyutto.
segments.snp3.10:16.1: “Mukhadugga vibhūta anariya, bhūnahu [bhunahata (syā. ka.)] pāpaka dukkaṭakāri;
segments.snp3.10:16.3: Purisanta kalī avajāta, mā bahubhāṇidha nerayikosi.
segments.snp3.10:17.3: Bahūni duccaritāni caritvā, gacchasi kho papataṃ cirarattaṃ.
segments.snp3.10:18.1: “Na hi nassati kassaci kammaṃ, eti hataṃ labhateva suvāmi;
segments.snp3.10:18.3: Dukkhaṃ mando paraloke, attani passati kibbisakārī.
segments.snp3.10:20.1: “Na hi vaggu vadanti vadantā, nābhijavanti na tāṇamupenti;
segments.snp3.10:20.3: Aṅgāre santhate sayanti [senti (sī. syā. pī.)], ginisampajjalitaṃ pavisanti.
segments.snp3.10:21.1: “Jālena ca onahiyāna, tattha hananti ayomayakuṭebhi [ayomayakūṭehi (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.snp3.10:21.3: Andhaṃva timisamāyanti, taṃ vitatañhi yathā mahikāyo.
segments.snp3.10:22.3: Paccanti hi tāsu cirarattaṃ, agginisamāsu [ginissamāsu (ka.)] samuppilavāte.
segments.snp3.10:23.3: Yaṃ yaṃ disakaṃ [disataṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] adhiseti, tattha kilissati samphusamāno.
segments.snp3.10:24.3: Gantuṃ na hi tīramapatthi, sabbasamā hi samantakapallā.
segments.snp3.10:26.3: Tattha mandā papatanti, pāpakarā pāpāni karitvā.
segments.snp3.10:27.1: “Khādanti hi tattha rudante, sāmā sabalā kākolagaṇā ca;
segments.snp3.10:27.3: Soṇā siṅgālā [sigālā (sī. pī.)] paṭigiddhā [paṭigijjhā (syā. pī.)], kulalā vāyasā ca [kulalā ca vāyasā (?)] vitudanti.
segments.snp3.10:28.1: “Kicchā vatayaṃ idha vutti, yaṃ jano phusati [passati (sī. syā. pī.)] kibbisakārī;
segments.snp3.10:28.3: Tasmā idha jīvitasese, kiccakaro siyā naro na cappamajje.
segments.snp3.10:29.1: “Te gaṇitā vidūhi tilavāhā, ye padume niraye upanītā;
segments.snp3.10:29.3: Nahutāni hi koṭiyo pañca bhavanti, dvādasa koṭisatāni punaññā [panayye (ka.)].
segments.snp3.10:30.1: “Yāva dukhā [dukkhā (sī. syā.), dukkha (pī. ka.)] nirayā idha vuttā, tatthapi tāva ciraṃ vasitabbaṃ;
segments.snp3.10:30.3: Tasmā sucipesalasādhuguṇesu, vācaṃ manaṃ satataṃ [pakataṃ (syā.)] parirakkhe”ti.

lines: Taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyoti yo uttamaṭṭhena pasaṃsāraho puggalo, taṃ vā so pāpicchatādīni āropetvā garahati.
Sabbassāpi sahāpi attanāti sabbena attano dhanenapi attanāpi saddhiṃ.
Sugatesū pi suṭṭhu gatattā, sundarañca ṭhānaṃ gatattā sugatanāmakesu buddhapaccekabuddhasāvakesu.
Tassāyaṃ manopadoso eva mahattaro kalīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Yasmā sataṃ sahassānaṃ … pe … pāpakaṃ, yasmā vassagaṇanāya ettako so kālo, yaṃ kālaṃ ariyagarahī vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya pāpakaṃ nirayaṃ upeti, tattha paccatīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Idāni aparenapi nayena “ayameva mahattaro kali, yo sugatesu manaṃ padūsaye”ti imamatthaṃ vibhāvento “abhūtavādī”ti ādimāha.
Pecca samā bhavantīti ito paṭigantvā nirayūpapattiyā samā bhavanti.
Appaduṭṭhattā vā suddhassa, suddhattā anaṅgaṇassāti evampettha yojetabbaṃ.
Evaṃ sugatesu manopadosassa mahattarakalibhāvaṃ sādhetvā idāni vāritavatthugāthā nāma cuddasa gāthā āha.
Imā kira kokālikaṃ mīyamānameva ovadantenāyasmatā mahāmoggallānena vuttā,“mahābrahmunā”ti eke.
Tāsaṃ iminā suttena saddhiṃ ekasaṅgahatthaṃ ayamuddeso “yo lobhaguṇe anuyutto”tiādi.
Tattha paṭhamagāthāya tāva “guṇo”ti niddiṭṭhattā anekakkhattuṃ pavattattā vā lobhoyeva lobhaguṇo, taṇhāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yo, āvuso kokālika, tumhādiso anuyuttalobhataṇhāya lobhaguṇe anuyutto assaddho kadariyo avadaññū maccharī pesuṇiyaṃ anuyutto, so vacasā paribhāsati aññaṃ abhāsaneyyampi puggalaṃ.

Tassāyaṃ anuttānapadattho – mukhadugga mukhavisama, vibhūta vigatabhūta, alikavādi, anariya asappurisa, bhūnahu bhūtihanaka, vuḍḍhināsaka, purisanta antimapurisa, kali alakkhipurisa, avajāta buddhassa avajātaputta.
Atha vā hatanti gataṃ paṭipannaṃ, upacitanti attho.
So hi taṃ kammaṃ labhateva, nāssa taṃ nassatīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Yasmā ca labhati, tasmā dukkhaṃ mando … pe … kibbisakārī.
Idāni yaṃ dukkhaṃ mando passati, taṃ pakāsento “ayosaṅkusamāhataṭṭhānan”tiādimāha.

Tattha purimaupaḍḍhagāthāya tāva attho – yaṃ taṃ ayosaṅkusamāhataṭṭhānaṃ sandhāya bhagavatā “tamenaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ karontī”ti (ma. ni.3.250; a. ni.3.36) vuttaṃ, taṃ upeti, evaṃ upento ca tattheva ādittāya lohapathaviyā nipajjāpetvā nirayapālehi pañcasu ṭhānesu ākoṭiyamānaṃ tattaṃ khilasaṅkhātaṃ tiṇhadhāramayasūlamupeti, yaṃ sandhāya bhagavatā vuttaṃ “tattaṃ ayokhilaṃ hatthe gamentī”tiādi.

Tato parā upaḍḍhagāthā anekāni vassasahassāni tattha paccitvā pakkāvasesānubhavanatthaṃ anupubbena khārodakanadītīraṃ gatassa yaṃ taṃ “tattaṃ ayoguḷaṃ mukhe pakkhipanti, tattaṃ tambalohaṃ mukhe āsiñcantī”ti vuttaṃ, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Ayogahaṇena cettha tambalohaṃ, itarena ayoguḷaṃ veditabbaṃ.
Tato parāsu gāthāsu na hi vaggūti “gaṇhatha, paharathā”tiādīni vadantā nirayapālā madhuravācaṃ na vadanti.
Nābhijavantīti na sumukhabhāvena abhimukhā javanti, na sumukhā upasaṅkamanti, anayabyasanamāvahantā eva upasaṅkamantīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Na tāṇamupentīti tāṇaṃ leṇaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ hutvā na upagacchanti, gaṇhantā hanantā eva upentīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Aṅgāre santhate sayantīti aṅgārapabbataṃ āropitā samānā anekāni vassasahassāni santhate aṅgāre senti.
Ginisampajjalitanti samantato jalitaṃ sabbadisāsu ca sampajjalitaṃ aggiṃ.
Mahānirayo nāma yo so “catukkaṇṇo”ti (a. ni.3.36) vutto, naṃ yojanasate ṭhatvā passataṃ akkhīni bhijjanti.
Jālena ca onahiyānāti ayojālena paliveṭhetvā migaluddakā migaṃ viya hananti.
Andhaṃva timisamāyantīti andhakaraṇena andhameva bahalandhakārattā “timisan”ti saññitaṃ dhūmaroruvaṃ nāma narakaṃ gacchanti.
Tatra kira nesaṃ kharadhūmaṃ ghāyitvā akkhīni bhijjanti, tena “andhaṃvā”ti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ vitatañhi yathā mahikāyoti tañca andhatimisaṃ mahikāyo viya vitataṃ hotīti attho.
Atha lohamayanti ayaṃ pana lohakumbhī pathavipariyantikā catunahutādhikāni dveyojanasatasahassāni gambhīrā samatittikā tatralohapūrā hoti.
Paccanti hi tāsu cirarattanti tāsu kumbhīsu dīgharattaṃ paccanti.
Samuppilavāteti samuppilavantā, sakimpi uddhaṃ sakimpi adho gacchamānā pheṇuddehakaṃ paccantīti vuttaṃ hoti.
“Abhisetī” tipi pāṭho, tattha yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ allīyati apassayatīti attho.
